metadata.title: Fix: Fullscreen mode in Resource Test closes immediately on first attempt
metadata.author: TS0713

description:
**Bug Fix**:
 - Fullscreen mode now remains open on the first and subsequent attempts when fullscreen button clicked
        
Addresses the issue #1787 

 ### Files Changed

`mcpgateway/static/admin.js`

  - Updated the runResourceTest function to prevent event bubbling and unintended navigation when opening fullscreen mode

commits.message:
fix(ui): prevent fullscreen mode from closing immediately in Resource Test

Prevent event bubbling and default actions when opening fullscreen mode
in the Resource Test panel. The click event was propagating to parent
elements with toggle handlers, causing the fullscreen overlay to close.

- Add event.preventDefault() to fullscreen button click handler
- Add click handlers on overlay and box elements to stop propagation

Closes #1787

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
